title: Message sender request
description: Body of P1 msg.send and arguments of P3 send_message. The sender sets only the type, the address (to or reply_to), fields, the note, its own idempotency key and an expiry not longer than the type's; the request has no core fields (CloudEvents attributes and botaru extensions), and the schema rejects a request with them (MSG-1). The report genus needs exactly one of to and reply_to; the state genus has no address: the value goes into the inboxes of the roles that accept the type (MSG-14, STA-1). For an agent attempt the core builds the tool schema the same way as tools/list: type and to are enums from the role's messages.send, fields is the closed schema of the type (MSG-5).

type.description: Message type <genus>.<name>.vN from the role's messages.send.

to.description: Address: role:<name> or group:<name> from the enum that the core builds from the role's messages.send (MSG-4). The request has no worker:<id> address: only the core writes it.

reply_to.description: Handle of the inbox entry that the core gave to this attempt: an opaque string, used to reply (reply_to) and to return the entry. The ids of the entry, the worker and the tenant are not visible in it.

fields.description: Fields by the closed schema of the type; at most the type's max_bytes, ceiling 4 KiB (MSG-15).

note.description: Note: a short text up to the type's note.max_chars, ceiling 500 characters; present only for report genus types that allow it; always untrusted (MSG-13).

idempotency_key.description: The sender's own idempotency key, or null.

anyOf.description: Idempotency key of the code; the core adds the sender prefix to it. Keys of the form system: are written only by the core (IDM-2).

ttl.description: Expiry of the entry; only shorter than the type's expiry (MSG-12).
